inventory.description: We use an AI-powered clinical decision support system within our hospital to assist doctors and healthcare professionals in diagnosing diseases, recommending treatment plans, and predicting patient risks based on historical medical data. The system analyses patient records, lab results, imaging data, and real-time vitals to provide evidence-based suggestions. Additionally, it helps in early detection of critical conditions such as sepsis, cancer, and heart disease by identifying hidden patterns that may not be easily visible to clinicians. The AI also supports workflow optimisation by prioritising cases based on urgency and improving patient care outcomes while reducing manual workload.
